The reviewer note raises a critical concern that the fix may be incomplete: voided captures are not being subtracted from the captured amount, which would allow refunds against voided captures. This represents a gap in the bug fix that contradicts the acceptance criteria of preventing over-refunding. While the agent's self-report claims all 118 tests pass, the witness-level observation suggests the implementation does not actually handle all over-refunding scenarios, particularly the void case.
